reason: Pages 10, 12 and 13 of this MS have a garbled text layer (split glyph runs such as '970 01/41', 'Ca ambridge Interna ational', 'Que estion', 'Ma arks', and each key split or doubled as '6' + '6(c)', '8' + '8(a)', '8(' + '(c)(ii)', '9' + '(c)(i)'), so the printed keys 6(c) (p10 y80.5), 6(d) (p10 y271.8), 8(a) (p12 y80.5), 8(b) (p12 y238.9), 8(c)(ii) (p12 y378.7), 8(c)(iii) (p12 y427.6), 9(a) (p13 y80.5), 9(b) (p13 y105.0) and 9(c)(ii) (p13 y153.9) were not read (6(c), 6(d) were unresolved; 8(a), 8(b), 8(c)(ii), 8(c)(iii), 9(a), 9(b), 9(c)(ii) were wrongly given the whole of Q8 / Q9), and the running header (y21-47), the 'Question Answer Marks' column-header row (y56-68) and the copyright footer (y550-559) of those pages were not recognised as furniture. The nine keys are placed by hand at their printed lines; the header, column-header row and footer of pages 10, 12 and 13 are whited out by position, and because the garbled word boxes do not match the drawn glyphs, every printed label in the Question column (x64-112) of those pages is whited out by hand.
